description: This is a Java unit test class named DeleteFeatureDefinitionTest for testing the DeleteFeatureDefinition functionality within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.modify package. It contains tests for immutability, equality, exception handling during creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object creation with valid parameters.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteFeatureDefinition, testing immutability, equality, exception handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object creation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DeleteFeatureDefinition instances are immutable, also ensuring ThingId is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies hashCode and equals methods for DeleteFeatureDefinition using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when creating DeleteFeatureDefinition with null string ThingId.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when creating DeleteFeatureDefinition with null ThingId object.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures a NullPointerException is thrown if feature ID is null.

methods.name: createInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Tests creating a DeleteFeatureDefinition instance with valid arguments.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that toJson produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON to create DeleteFeatureDefinition object and verifies its content.
